segments.name: Social commerce
segments.description: Operates a social commerce platform linking product discovery, user content, affiliate commerce and rewards.
segments.evidence: The Company operates as a single operating and reportable segment.

revenueModel.text: Affiliate networks pay commissions on qualifying retailer purchases, and advertisers pay for sponsored placements on the platform.
revenueModel.evidence: Users complete transactions directly with third-party retailers, and the Company generates revenue primarily through affiliate commission arrangements and advertising-related placements.
